tagline: Kitchen & Bathroom Remodeling in Wilkes-Barre, PA

team_members.name: Patrick Healey
team_members.bio: Pat graduated from Johnson College and spent almost 30 years as a home builder in the area before purchasing Morris Kitchens in January 2016. That construction background is why our installations are handled in-house.

team_members.name: Celeste Donnelly
team_members.bio: Celeste joined Morris Kitchens in October 2016. She holds a bachelor's of fine arts in interior design from Marywood University, and worked at a kitchen design center and then a local tile store for twelve years before that. She measures and designs every project herself.

why_choose_us.title: In business since 1995
why_choose_us.description: Thirty-one years in the Wyoming Valley, and in the same West End Plaza showroom since 2008. You can drive to us.

why_choose_us.title: Your designer measures your room
why_choose_us.description: Celeste walks your space and takes the measurements herself. No subcontracted measuring, no design drawn off someone else's numbers.

why_choose_us.title: In-house installers
why_choose_us.description: The same company that designs your kitchen orders it and installs it. One point of contact from the first drawing to the last piece of trim.

why_choose_us.title: Timelines we put in writing
why_choose_us.description: Six to eight weeks for a full kitchen, one to two weeks for countertops, three weeks on HomeCrest cabinets. We publish the numbers before you sign anything.
